How this CLI compares to Palantir's published MCP tool catalog. Each of
the 72 tools and 1 workflow is
classified against the live command surface, so the implemented/planned
split can never disagree with `pltr agent-manifest`; `blocked` and
`unsupported` are classified explicitly.

- **Catalog:** `palantir-mcp-available-tools-2026-07-20` ([source](https://www.palantir.com/docs/foundry/palantir-mcp/available-tools/), retrieved 2026-07-20)
- **Totals:** 20 implemented, 28 planned, 2 blocked, 23 unsupported (of 73)
